pages.text: A Redstone Monstrosity that died in the deep dark, and was taken by the sculk. It does not rise from redstone, but around the heart of a Warden.$(br2)$(bold)900 health, 28 attack, 8 armor$()$(br)(by default)

pages.name: Sculk Monstrosity Mold
pages.text: Right click the Warden Core with an Animation Core.

pages.title: The Mold
pages.text: $(li)Sculk Sensors for the ring (calibrated ones too)$(li)Sculk Catalysts for the fill$(li)Four Sculk Shriekers round the core$(li)A Warden Core at its heart$(br2)Everything but the bricks and Diamond Mold Blocks is used up as it rises, and its shriekers shriek one last time.
Every Warden carries a Warden Core, and gives it up when slain. The souls inside it still beat with the Warden's heart.$(br2)Crafted on its own, it breaks into four Echo Shards.

pages.title: Sculk Decay
pages.text: Every blow it lands spreads $(bold)Sculk Decay$(), which stacks up to ten times and eats through armor.$(br2)Whatever dies while decaying rises again to fight for it for three minutes, as itself or as a sculk zombie.

pages.title: Special Attack
pages.text: It slams with its tentacle arm, and belches globs of sculk that leave a creeping mire.$(br2)Its special attack raises four to six tentacles from the ground around its foes, each slamming down twice.
Should it fall, it leaves its head, which remembers its master. Build the frame on the next page and set the head on top, in the middle, last.
